Q2 FY2026 Highlights:
1. Revenue for Q2 FY 2026 was $200.6B, surging 20% YoY on strong growth in cloud and e-commerce.
2. AWS Revenue was at $42.2B, surging by 37% YoY, its fastest growth in 18 quarters.
3. Amazon reported operating Income of $27.5B, increased by 43% YoY, as AWS profitability continued to improve.
4. Advertising Revenue stood at $19.8B

Looking Ahead
1. For 2026, Amazon expects CapEx to be raised to $220B (from $200B) to expand AI infrastructure and cloud capacity.
2. AI & Custom Chips both surpassed a $25B annual revenue run rate.
3. The company expects Q3 Revenue to be around $197B-$202B, due in part to Prime Day shifting into Q2.

Despite higher AI spending and negative free cash flow, investors focused on one thing: AWS is accelerating. Strong cloud growth, a record backlog, and continued AI demand sent Amazon shares more than 10% higher after earnings.
